t: This is the former Charing Cross Hospital, the east side, a building in Westminster. It was designed by Decimus Burton, one of the foremost English architects and landscapers of the nineteenth century. He was the leading Victorian architect in the Roman Revival, Greek Revival and Georgian neoclassical styles, and a founding fellow of the Royal Institute of British Architects. He also designed the Athenaeum Club's clubhouse, which his father, the property developer James Burton, helped to build. Look for his classical touch in the proportions.
